name: flow_loading_card_states
description: The leader of a party of three starts once the others are Ready: the 3-2-1 counts over the button, then the server's MATCH_CONFIG opens the loading barrier over the match scene. One card per player shows its seat's state as LOAD_STATE gives it: Connecting, a percentage, Checking once loaded while others load, Slow 0:15 from 15 s with the line naming the seat everyone waits for, Ready when all have loaded; then START, turn 0, and the match.

steps.msg: the leader's Start waits for everyone to be Ready

steps.assert: (node('HubPanel').primary_text() == '3') and (node('PrimaryLine').text == 'Starting in 3 · Enter cancels') and not node('Primary').disabled
steps.msg: 3-2-1 over the button; anyone can cancel, and the line names the key
a seat that has not reported yet is Connecting

steps.assert: node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen').find_child('LoadingTitle', true, false).text == 'HIGH WATER  ·  WICKHOLLOW  ·  12 waves' and node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen').line_text() == 'Walking out'
steps.msg: the mode, the map and its waves; the line walks out
Checking once loaded, a percentage while loading, Connecting before

steps.assert: node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen').find_child('Card2', true, false).get_node('Box/Bar').visible and not node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen').find_child('Card3', true, false).get_node('Box/Bar').visible
steps.msg: a loading seat shows its bar
the match waits behind the barrier
from 15 s a seat not yet loaded is Slow, with the seconds
and the line names the seat everyone waits for
the line follows the seat still loading

steps.wait_until: node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen').card_lines() == ['Sascha Lamplighter Ready', 'Ana Lamplighter Ready', 'Ben Lamplighter Ready']

steps.assert: node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen') == null and Session.client.phase_name() == 'IN_MATCH' and Game.accepts_commands()
steps.msg: turn 0 runs: the barrier goes and orders go out
a match of the three, me in seat 1
